title: Web (Three.js)
description: A model for a website: opens right in the browser on a desktop or laptop. A balance between good image quality and fast loading.

availableExtensions.title: KTX2 texture compression
availableExtensions.description: Converts textures to a GPU format: saves up to ~80% of video memory. Requires KTX2Loader support in Three.js (or basisu in another engine).
availableExtensions.impact: The file may grow 5–10%, but texture video memory drops several-fold.

availableExtensions.title: Draco geometry compression
availableExtensions.description: Minimal file weight (often −50% on geometry). Decodes slower than Meshopt in the browser but is supported everywhere.
availableExtensions.impact: The file is noticeably lighter; decoding on open is slower.

availableExtensions.title: Remove vertex colors
availableExtensions.description: Removes painted vertex colors. Enable only if vertex colors are not visible in the model (white channels are removed without this option too).
availableExtensions.impact: Saves 5–20% of size if colors exist; may change the look if they were used.

notes: triangles 100000 — target value from the Khronos 3D Commerce (real-time) recommendations for a single object in the scene.
textureMaxSize 2048 — Khronos 3D Commerce recommendation: 2K as a reasonable maximum for the web.
drawCalls 50 — guideline: keep the primitive count low for stable 60 fps on mid-range hardware.
vramMB 128 — guideline for a desktop/laptop GPU when viewing in the browser.
fileMB 10 — guideline: a file this size loads in the browser within a few seconds on ordinary internet.
noKtx true — v0.0.8: baseline plan without KTX2 (textures stay PNG/WebP, work in any browser); KTX2 is an extension enabled by explicit user choice.
texMode uastc — if the user enables the ktx2 extension: on desktop there is headroom for traffic, so we pick the more precise GPU texture format for image quality.
extension id = core feature name: web-interface passes the selected ids to optimizeFile as advancedFeatures; the opts field is the equivalent for the legacy path.
